plain.li: [feastwelcome,us] Welcome, come in, there's a seat for you at the table tonight.
[feastwelcome,us] You found us, good, the others are waiting by the gate.
[feastwelcome,us,lowtech] Welcome, and leave the road's dust at the gate.
[feastwelcome,us,!lowtech] Glad you made it, the others have been watching the road for you.
[feastwelcome,us,theirLowtech] Be welcome, you and those who walk with you.
[feastarrive,them] We came as soon as the road let us.
[feastarrive,them] So this is your colony, smaller than I pictured and better kept.
[feastarrive,them,theirLowtech] We bring our hunger and our best runners, as is right.
[feastarrive,them,theirLowtech] We bring our people's greetings, and a good appetite.
[feastarrive,them,theirHightech] Thank you for having us, I'm told there's a program for the day.
[feastrungo] On the word, out to the marker and back, and go.
[feastrungo] Everyone on the line, and off you go.
[feastrungo,lowtech] Run, and may the ground be kind to your feet.
[feastrunstumble] My foot caught on something at the turn.
[feastrunstumble] Down I go, of all the places to trip.
[feastrunwin] First back, and I'm hardly out of breath.
[feastrunwin,them] Our legs are used to longer roads than this.
[feastrunwin,us] That's our ground, and I know every stone of it.
[feastrunlose] You were faster today, I'll grant you that.
[feastrunlose] I had you until the turn.
[feasthuntwin] That's the best bag of the day, and I'll carry it in myself.
[feasthuntwin,them,theirLowtech] Your land is generous, tell your hunters I said so.
[feasthuntwin,us] There's meat for the feast now, thanks to a steady hand.
[feasttablewin] A good game, and closer than the board makes it look.
[feasttablewin,them] Play me again before we leave and I'll give you a start.
[feasttablewin,us] You'll have to come back and win it back.
[feasttablelose] Well played, I didn't see that last move coming.
[feasttablelose] Next time I'm keeping my eyes on your hands.
[feastshootgood] That's most of them in the middle, let's see you beat it.
[feastshootgood,them,theirHightech] Not bad on a borrowed range.
[feastshootfair] Fair enough, though the wind took one.
[feastshootfair] Middling, and I'll blame the light.
[feastshootpoor] I won't be telling anyone at home about that.
[feastshootpoor] The target can keep its peace, I barely touched it.
[feastwinner] To the cooks, and to everyone I beat today.
[feastwinner,them] We'll be talking about this all the way home.
[feastwinner,us] Not bad for a day at home.
[feastwinner,lowtech] Fill the cups, it's been a good day.
[feastprize,us] This is yours, and you earned it.
[feastprize,us] The prize, for the best of the day.
[feastprize,us,theirLowtech] Take it home, and tell them how you won it.
[feastprizethanks] I'll keep it where people can see it.
[feastprizethanks,them] They won't believe this at home.
[feastprizethanks,us] I'll look after it.
[feastsour,them] Say that again and see what happens.
[feastsour,them] You've been laughing at me since the race.
[feastsour,them,theirLowtech] Nobody at home would dare speak to me like that.
[invitation,warm,feast:invited] We would be glad to come, {WRITER}. Keep a place for us at {FEAST}.
[invitation,warm,feast:invited,theirLowtech] We will walk to you for {FEAST}, and bring our best for the contests.
[invitation,warm,feast:invited,theirHightech] Invitation accepted with pleasure. We'll arrive in good time for {FEAST}.
[invitation,cordial,feast:invited] Thank you for asking us, {WRITER}. We'll come for {FEAST}.
[invitation,cordial,feast:invited,theirLowtech] Our people have heard of your feasts. We will come and see one.
[invitation,cordial,feast:invited,call] Count us in. We'll set out once we've seen to things here.
[invitation,cool,feast:invited] Thank you, {WRITER}, but we can't come to {FEAST} this time.
[invitation,cool,feast:invited,theirLowtech] The season keeps us at home. We cannot come to your feast.
[invitation,cool,feast:invited,theirHightech] Regrettably our schedule won't allow it. Our thanks for the invitation.
[invitation,curt,feast:invited] We won't be coming.
[invitation,refusal,feast:invited] We do not sit at your table.
[greetings,cordial,feast:soon] We are looking forward to {FEAST}, {WRITER}. Our people are already arguing over who gets to go.
[news,cordial,feast:soon] Here is our news. The rest we will tell you in person at {FEAST}.
[greetings,warm,them:feastguest,feast:welcomed] I still think of {FEAST}, {WRITER}. Thank you again for having us.
[greetings,cordial,them:feastguest] Your letter came as I was telling someone about {FEAST}.
[greetings,cordial,town:lately:dip:feast] Our people came home from {FEAST} with plenty to say about your colony.
[greetings,warm,town:lately:dip:feast] Those who went to your feast still talk of it.
[news,cordial,town:lately:dip:feast] Before the news: the ones who went to {FEAST} haven't stopped talking about it.
[greetings,cordial,feast:theywon] {CHAMPION} came home from {FEAST} rather pleased, as you may imagine.
[greetings,cordial,feast:wewon] Our people say {CHAMPION} carried the day at {FEAST}. They want another chance.
[greetings,cool,feast:wewon] We hear little else from those who went to {FEAST} but how badly they lost.
[invitation,warm,town:lately:dip:feast] After {FEAST}, it's only right we come and see you again.
[help,cordial,them:feastguest,feast:welcomed] You were good hosts at {FEAST}. We can spare something in return.
[greetings,cool,them:feastguest,feast:slighted] I have not forgotten {FEAST}, {WRITER}, nor the empty plate.
